rubric.scale: 0 = fails; 1 = partially meets; 2 = meets; null = cannot assess

dimensions.instruction_following: Does the response follow the instruction and constraints?
dimensions.correctness: Are factual, logical and computational claims supportable? Mark uncertainty instead of inventing verification.
dimensions.relevance_completeness: Does the response address the input and include the necessary content?
dimensions.clarity: Is the response understandable without unnecessary repetition?

rubric.decision_rule: keep only if all four scores are 2; reject if any score is 0; otherwise review (including uncertainty). This conservative draft rule needs validation.
